_meta.source_version: MITRE Engage v1.0 (release v1.0.0, 8 Mar 2022), sin cambios en la matriz desde el 28/2/2022
_meta.verification_methodology: IDs, nombres y descripciones de Goals/Approaches/Activities tomados literal del dataset publico oficial (raw.githubusercontent.com/mitre/engage/main/Data/json/{goals,approaches,activities}.json, licencia Apache-2.0). La relacion many-to-many Approach->Activity y Goal->Approach no viene en un archivo de relaciones separado en ese repo (no se encontro uno) -- se tomo de la matriz visual real (engage.mitre.org/matrix/), verificada en un fetch anterior de esta misma investigacion, y cruzada contra los IDs oficiales de este dataset. Cada Activity puede pertenecer a mas de un Approach (ej. 'Lures' aparece en Detect/Direct/Disrupt) -- por eso approach_ids es una lista, no un campo unico.

goals.name: Prepare
goals.description: Help the defender think about what they want to accomplish with operations.

goals.name: Understand
goals.description: Make sure that the defender is capturing, utilizing, and refining knowledge learned to improve the defender's posture.

goals.name: Expose
goals.description: Reveal the presence of ongoing adversary operations.

goals.name: Elicit
goals.description: Learn about adversaries tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

approaches.name: Plan
approaches.description: Identify and align an operation with a desired end-state.

approaches.name: Analyze
approaches.description: Retrospective review of information gained from an operation.

approaches.name: Collect
approaches.description: Gather adversary tools, observe tactics, and collect other raw intelligence about the adversary's activity.

approaches.name: Detect
approaches.description: Establish or maintain awareness regarding adversary activity.

approaches.name: Prevent
approaches.description: Stop all or part of the adversary's ability to conduct their operation as intended.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.description: Encourage or discourage the adversary from conducting their operation as intended.

approaches.name: Disrupt
approaches.description: Impair an adversary's ability to conduct their operation as intended.

approaches.name: Reassure
approaches.description: Add authenticity to deceptive components to convince an adversary that an environment is real.

approaches.name: Motivate
approaches.description: Encourage an adversary to conduct part or all of their mission.

activities.name: API Monitoring
activities.description: Monitor local APIs that might be used by adversary tools and activity.

activities.name: Network Monitoring
activities.description: Monitor network traffic in order to detect adversary activity.

activities.name: System Activity Monitoring
activities.description: Collect system activity logs that can reveal adversary activity.

activities.name: Network Analysis
activities.description: Analyze network traffic to gain intelligence on communications between systems.

activities.name: Lures
activities.description: Deceptive systems and artifacts intended to serve as decoys, breadcrumbs, or bait to elicit a specific response from the adversary.

activities.name: Application Diversity
activities.description: Present the adversary with a variety of installed applications and services.

activities.name: Network Diversity
activities.description: Use a diverse set of devices on the network to help establish the legitimacy of a deceptive network.

activities.name: Burn-In
activities.description: Exercise a target system in a manner where it will generate desirable system artifacts.

activities.name: Email Manipulation
activities.description: Modify the flow of email in the environment.

activities.name: Peripheral Management
activities.description: Manage peripheral devices used on systems within the network for engagement purposes.

activities.name: Pocket Litter
activities.description: Data used to support the engagement narrative.

activities.name: Personas
activities.description: Create fictitious human user(s) through a combination of planted data and revealed behavior patterns.

activities.name: Malware Detonation
activities.description: Execute malware under controlled conditions to analyze its functionality.

activities.name: Software Manipulation
activities.description: Make changes to a system's software properties and functions to achieve a desired effect.

activities.name: Information Manipulation
activities.description: Conceal and reveal both facts and fictions to support a deception story

activities.name: Network Manipulation
activities.description: Make changes to network properties and functions to achieve a desired effect.

activities.name: Hardware Manipulation
activities.description: Alter the hardware configuration of a system to limit what an adversary can do with the device.

activities.name: Security Controls
activities.description: Alter security controls to make the system more or less vulnerable to attack.

activities.name: Baseline
activities.description: Identify key system elements to establish a baseline and be prepared to reset a system to that baseline when necessary.

activities.name: Isolation
activities.description: Configure devices, systems, networks, etc. to contain activity and data, thus preventing the expansion of an engagement beyond desired limits.

activities.name: Attack Vector Migration
activities.description: Move a malicious link, file, or device from its intended location to an engagement system or network for execution/use.

activities.name: Artifact Diversity
activities.description: Present the adversary with a variety of network and system artifacts.

activities.name: Introduced Vulnerabilities
activities.description: Intentionally introduce vulnerabilities into the environment for the adversary to exploit.

activities.name: Operational Objective
activities.description: Define the objective of the desired end-state of your adversary engagement operations.

activities.name: Persona Creation
activities.description: Plan and create a fictitious human user through a combination of planted data and revealed behavior patterns.

activities.name: Storyboarding
activities.description: Plan and create the deception story.

activities.name: Cyber Threat Intelligence
activities.description: The process of analyzing actionable knowledge about adversaries and their malicious activities, enabling defenders and their organizations to reduce harm through better security decision-making

activities.name: Gating Criteria
activities.description: Define the set of events that would lead to the unnegotiable pause or conclusion to the operation.

activities.name: After-Action Review
activities.description: Review of operational activities.

activities.name: Engagement Environment
activities.description: Design the systems and network for the operation.

activities.name: Threat Model
activities.description: A risk assessment that models organizational strengths and weaknesses
